title: documents.php list response
description: 200 for action=list: every Co-Pilot document of the patient in the session, newest first. Filenames are the physician's own upload names and stay inside the session; they are never logged.

failure_reason.description: Why the last extraction failed, a fixed code from run.response (encrypted, unreadable, too_many_pages, model_error, schema_mismatch, timeout) or a sidecar transport code (unavailable, timeout); null when stored or extracted.

confidence.description: Share of extracted fields the anchor step could prove on the page; null until extracted.

uploaded_at.description: MySQL datetime of the upload (server time).

correlation_id.description: Correlation id of the request; quote it when reporting a problem.
